scope: Motor-count/circuit decision support, not a fabricated drivetrain or complete3N.2 physical installation

development_dispositions.subject: Single H1B110 with mechanical distribution to powered axles
development_dispositions.disposition: Retain as lead comparison from the recovered workbook, not final selection. It avoids a parallel branch-flow split but requires a complete custom mechanically supported reduction/distribution and articulated axle drives.

development_dispositions.subject: Two H1B060 motors in parallel
development_dispositions.disposition: Retain alternative. Full60cc with9:1 is slower than original; controlled55cc or a changed ratio can rematch speed. All-flow branch faults, reverse/retarding and control fail states must be resolved; more motors do not add engine power.

development_dispositions.subject: Two H1B110 motors in parallel at9:1
development_dispositions.disposition: Not a like-for-like substitute: half equal-share speed. Rematching ratio or displacement changes torque/speed, not total power. Do not carry the old matching figures into this arrangement.

development_dispositions.subject: Series H1B motors
development_dispositions.disposition: Exclude from the current preferred development path absent specific Danfoss application acceptance. OEM warns of bearing-life consequences; not treated as an easy equal-speed solution.

development_dispositions.subject: Generic flow divider or combiner
development_dispositions.disposition: Not selected. Both-direction, return-side/cavitation, pressure/flow range, droop, flushing and heat must be accepted. Do not substitute a one-way divider for a reversing train.

physical_interfaces.fixed_to: Custom locomotive main frame through an accepted vibration/torsional mounting system
physical_interfaces.connection_to_define: Engine flywheel/pump coupling, housing pilots and support; no adapter/hole size accepted.

physical_interfaces.assembly: Frame/bogie-mounted single motor and supported reduction/distributor
physical_interfaces.fixed_to: One defined sprung frame reference, not two independently moving references
physical_interfaces.connection_to_define: Supported gear shafts and sealed bearing seats; motor output coupling without unaccepted side load; each output drive allows the actual relative motion.

physical_interfaces.fixed_to: Bearings on the rotating axle permit gearcase support; housing itself remains nonrotating
physical_interfaces.moves_relative_to: Sprung frame in bounce/roll/lateral travel and bogie yaw where present
physical_interfaces.connection_to_define: Articulated torque reaction into the correct frame. Do not turn the torque rod or driveshaft into an unintended rigid suspension guide.

physical_interfaces.fixed_to: Mating drive and driven flanges with supported axes
physical_interfaces.moves_relative_to: Required axial plunge and multi-axis joint angles
physical_interfaces.connection_to_define: Actual shafts, phasing, plunge, critical speed, retained fasteners, guards and inspection access. No road-driveshaft catalog angle automatically accepted for a rail installation.

physical_interfaces.fixed_to: Either accepted sprung mounts with articulated drive or an accepted axle-ride assembly; not both simultaneously
physical_interfaces.moves_relative_to: Hoses and supports must follow the selected kinematic references
physical_interfaces.connection_to_define: Motor order code, gearcase/shaft support, case drains, flexible hoses and guards across complete travel. Additional mass changes wheel loads/suspension.

load_path_rules: Single motor300bar torque proxy472.69N m and combined wheel torque4041.50N m derive from3N.1, not accepted design load.
Two powered axles do not justify rating every downstream branch for exactly half the total torque. Actual distribution and traction faults can make one branch govern.
Final gearcase reaction is vector equilibrium of actual input/output shaft torques and bearing forces. Do not use one arbitrary scalar arm to define all mounts.
Final drivetrain supports must include reversal, pressure transients, adhesion recovery, torsional vibration and fatigue, not just steady torque.
release_gates: N-G01 through N-G07 remain open in ../propulsion-n1/interfaces-and-release.json.
Exact locomotive chassis and powered axle geometry, mass/adhesion, reduction topology and suspension movement must precede mount dimensions.
If parallel motors advance: actual controls/default displacement, full-flow fault limit, independent speed sensing and reverse/retarding circuit life review.
Actual valve data, combined pressure and heat curves, flushing and charge balance before cooler/compressor auxiliaries are finalized.
next_useful_work: 3N.3: documented alternative transmission/electric comparisons and actual drive support/gear architecture. Continue3O/3P independent engineering if exact drive geometry remains held. Do not declare a locomotive fabricated assembly complete.
